author: reek
body: Physically-based rendering from Codex [Device] AST: a row of seven spheres of the same gold albedo but increasing roughness, shaded with the Cook-Torrance microfacet BRDF -- GGX normal distribution, Smith geometry, Schlick Fresnel -- lit by one key light and an ambient fill. One GPU thread per pixel casts a ray, folds over the spheres for the nearest hit, and evaluates the BRDF. The whole BRDF needs only multiply/divide/sqrt, so it comes straight from DeviceMath (no pow: the roughness powers are products and Fresnel's (1-c)^5 is five multiplies). This is the reference site's "PBR basic" technique.

author: reek
body: Evaluate one light: half vector, GGX * Smith * Fresnel specular plus a Lambert diffuse, scaled by N.L. albedo is the gold base colour.
